user_result: Games are noticeably smoother after changing FrameSkip from 1 to 0. User requests saving the corrected profile and 4x Native internal resolution for stable and nightly builds.

settings.notes: Only FrameSkip and internal resolution are confirmed by this acceptance. Other exploratory performance suggestions are not adopted. Internal resolution was already 4 in the previous saved packages.

implementation: Configuration-only change; emulator, launcher, worker, updater and automatic-sorting catalogue remain byte-identical to accepted inputs. Both nightly slots get new IDs and signed requirements for the corrected profile.
